# Contributing to Bati

The guide lives at [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) in the repository root, next to
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), which holds the rules that actually gate a change.

This file is a pointer rather than a copy. It used to be a second guide, and it had drifted:
it told contributors the codebase used no semicolons (Biome enforces `semicolons: "always"`), it
described a project layout with no `modules/` in it, and it was the version GitHub linked from the
new-issue page. Two contributing guides means the wrong one is read, and it is always the stale
one. So there is one, and this is the sign pointing at it.

- Code: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- The docs wiki: [`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Something that should not be a public issue: [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md)
